answer.reason: The verses tell of her destroying the royal seed, reigning over Judah, and being slain, which go beyond the summary.

clauses.english: destroyed all the royal offspring after her son Ahaziah died
clauses.quote: she arose and destroyed all the seed royal

clauses.english: reigned over the land while Joash was hidden in the house of the LORD six years
clauses.quote: And Athaliah did reign over the land.

clauses.english: was slain with the sword after crying "Treason" at the crowning of Joash
clauses.quote: they slew Athaliah with the sword beside the king's house

doubts: 2KI 11:2 and 2CH 22:11 mainly concern Jehosheba hiding Joash, so they are not cited for the clauses about Athaliah.
2CH 24:7 says her sons broke up the house of God; this is about her sons, so it is not used.
